arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Nathan argued the case presents a narrow issue. He stated clear standards guide the city's decisions. He claimed this renders decisions subject to effective review.
Mr. Cole argued prompt judicial determination is not necessary. He stated review must correlate to First Amendment concerns. He cited Court cases demonstrating this principle.
Mr. Gross argued the core policy protects expression. He stated a decision to issue a license must be made. He noted zoning laws act as secondary effects laws.
